summary: Zero-copy native GPU->QSV HEVC Main10 4K encode path is fully functional. SceneGraph -> D3D11 render (RGBA16F) -> compute convert into P010 encoder surface (UAV) -> MFXVideoENCODE -> Annex-B HEVC. No CPU pixels anywhere (readback_bytes_per_frame=0).

root_causes_fixed.fix: Skipped QueryIOSurf entirely (oneVPL hello-encode does not call it); fixed surface pool of 8. TOASTOVAC_SKIP_IOSURF=1 is now the default path.
root_causes_fixed.source: hevcehw_base_legacy.cpp Legacy::QueryIOSurf validation could not be satisfied with FFmpeg-identical params

root_causes_fixed.fix: Pass a real mfxBitstream (was null_mut). hevcehw_base_impl.cpp EncodeFrameCheck starts with MFX_CHECK_NULL_PTR2(bs, pEntryPoint) - the bitstream is mandatory.
BITSTREAM_CAP 4MiB -> 16MiB. hevcehw_base_legacy.cpp BLK_CheckBsData requires MaxLength >= BufferSizeInKB*1000 (5,000,000 bytes for buf=5000).

root_causes_fixed.symptom: MFXVideoCORE_SyncOperation failed: -2; tasks never produced AUs
root_causes_fixed.fix: GetHDL must FILL the runtime's mfxHDLPair buffer { first: ID3D11Texture2D*, second: 0 } (FFmpeg hwcontext_qsv.c frame_get_hdl convention). Our old callback returned a pointer to a stack-local pair (dangling) and later NULL_PTR for empty pairs, killing the encode task's texture resolution.
root_causes_fixed.source: FFmpeg hwcontext_qsv.c frame_get_hdl + runtime allocator contract

root_causes_fixed.symptom: MFXVideoENCODE_Query with separate output struct returns -2
root_causes_fixed.fix: Use in-place Query (same struct in/out) like the working path; the runtime's CheckBuffers requires out->NumExtParam == in->NumExtParam, so a zeroed separate output throws (caught as NULL_PTR). Re-assert IOPattern/NumExtParam/ExtParam after the in-place call rewrites the capability struct.

root_causes_fixed.symptom: status values misinterpreted (WRN_DEVICE_BUSY=2 treated as fatal)
root_causes_fixed.fix: oneVPL 2.x renumbered statuses: WRN_IN_EXECUTION=1, WRN_DEVICE_BUSY=2, NOT_INITIALIZED=-8, MORE_DATA=-10. Constants already matched vpl_api headers; added DEVICE_BUSY retry loop like FFmpeg qsvenc.c.

known_limitations.item: Ext buffers (AUDelimiter, RepeatPPS, mfxExtVideoSignalInfo, MasteringDisplay/ContentLightLevel SEI) are NOT consumed by the runtime Init path: output has no AUD NALs (0/60), PPS repeated only at IDR points (2/60), VUI color info unknown. Runtime support exists (m_ebCopySupported lists CDOP/CDO2/VSIN) but Init ignores the attached buffers. Needs runtime-level investigation (possible MFXVideoENCODE_UpdateVideoParam path or per-frame EncodeCtrl ext attach).
known_limitations.impact: Stream currently lacks HDR VUI/SEI signaling; TV would not auto-switch to HDR.

known_limitations.item: Standalone runs cap at 61 frames due to stdin-EOF early-exit (eof && rendered > 60). Live pipeline feeds stdin continuously, so unaffected.
TOASTOVAC_SKIP_IOSURF=1 (fixed 8-surface pool) is required; QueryIOSurf remains -15.
known_limitations.impact: Pool size fixed at 8; adequate for async_depth 2 with serialized submits.

tzhl_integration.pump: pump_native exact-read framed stdout, kind-1 AU -> AU assembler -> TZHL :8768
tzhl_integration.state_feed: native_state_loop framed JSON at FPS (live/fps/pq HUD)
tzhl_integration.known_gap: box reconnect is client-side (clients=0 after cast_host restarts); idr_sent/bytes_sent prove the delivery path

next: HDR VUI/SEI signaling via UpdateVideoParam or per-frame EncodeCtrl ext attach
